newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London firmer but trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London firmer but trade thin.

text.p: Japanese stocks trading in London were mostly higher on Thursday and dealers said they expected to see the Nikkei opening unchanged or firmer in Tokyo.
But they said trade in London was thin and there had been little sign of a follow-through from Tokyo's 51-point rise.

"It's very quiet," one said. "Blue chips are a little firmer while some of the banks are a little weaker. But we've seen no follow through in London at all and some of the blue chips are looking better offered now, if anything."
By 1140 GMT, the Nikkei 50 average in London was up 13.96 at 1,360.69.

"We are expecting perhaps a slightly firmer to unchanged market tomorrow," a dealer said. "Some of the volatility we've seen recently should come out of the market in the short term and we'll be hovering around these levels."
One dealer said he expected to see some bargain-hunting in the banking stocks although this had not yet emerged.
